node.statement: The polar map referred to by lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws is Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H on calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), with image S_delta, as referred to by the same polar inverse notation in def-approximate-unitary-space and expanded in the root. An inverse function, when it exists, is unique; denote its component functions (u_delta,h_delta). Thus the u_delta used in 1.4.1 is exactly the first component required at the root, and renaming the external lemma's arbitrary third unitary from W to Z avoids collision with the witness tuple without changing any assertion.
